esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; Gravity ORP sensor (DFRobot Analog ORP Sensor PRO) needs at least 5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.A → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on A: it swings to 5 V, and the D32 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the gravity_orp_pro.py driver written from the datasheet.
Converts the A voltage to ORP (oxidising water): passes
